singlePixels.method: Same actual source-reset/60steps oblique runtime. All stage pixels except explicit UI overlay rectangles. No resizing, warping, alignment or image editing.

mathAndSource.explanation: Full original encoded pixels, geometry, UVs, indices and eye/oral programs retained. Six controlled single renders are pixel-identical to R07. Group poses intentionally differ. Actual GPU eye inverse-transpose and full native cached rotation transform feedback measured independently; CPU school acceleration uses committed solver rates, not averaged renderer yaw.

actualVisualReview.method: Inspected fresh frozen ce30 live cruise/turn screenshots for all six species, plus actual continuous motion, source-envelope projection and pause/pointer sequence. Original identities, materials and continuous surfaces retained; no newly missing fish, visible fractured patch or default camera edge clipping found.

previousRejectedCandidate.reason: Actual native fixed-distance camera clipped full display OBBs in 12/60 pointer/recovery samples. This was a real camera defect; final overview adapter passes 60/60 while solver/geometry/shaders remain unchanged.

limits: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage measures page renderer JS heap; it is not total Chrome process/worker/native/GPU memory. backingStorageSize is reported separately when available.

WebGL byte accounting counts explicit currently live buffer/texture/renderbuffer storage including mipmaps, without driver alignment, shader/program storage, implicit framebuffer or VRAM physical residency.
Instrumentation holds live resource handles until explicit delete; this is for deterministic allocation accounting and can inhibit automatic GC cleanup of forgotten resources.
Fixed-pose screenshots are internal actual 3D QA evidence, not user visual acceptance.

Frozen R07 solver source is evaluated in independent same-realm isolated global objects; CPU timings exclude WebGL, browser drawing and body/eye upload. Actual browser costs are a later separate gate.
OBB clearance encloses source geometry, not exact instantaneous mesh-mesh collision. Separation and graph analysis occur outside timed solver updates.

Positions/velocities are normalized by canonical body length (five-source BL=1; barracuda original source length uses native metre scale and individual source variant size). This is an engineering comparison, not measured biological calibration.
REST must be tested as the real adapter does: native collective School.update is held during REST. Five-source solver is updated with mode rest.
Full sequence is deliberately bounded; 45-second cruise is a long baseline relative to other cases, not indefinite stability proof.

JS heap is not total process, worker or GPU memory. Explicit GL storage is not physical VRAM or driver/implicit framebuffer memory. Persistent school state increases JS heap slightly while full source GPU storage stays exact.
Default overview changes pixel coverage; this is not reported as a GPU algorithm speedup. Same-realm CPU solver cost is a separate measured comparison.
No universal 60 FPS claim: full-detail sea-wolf school retains approximately 33.4 ms p95 on this RTX 4070 Ti SUPER machine.

The 42-case independent bounded trajectories include variable dt and 45-second cruise; producer multi-seed 120-second proofs supplement rather than replace independent checks. This is not indefinite stability or biological species calibration.
Two tuna sources retain existing supported mouth motion. The other four retain original mouth posture/HOLD. No new unsupported mouth binding.
Local promotion only. User aesthetic/naturalness acceptance and public deployment approval are not granted by this technical report.
